description: Audits factual statements against authoritative consensus sources and assigns truthfulness scores with counter-evidence. Use when checking disputed claims, detecting AI hallucinations, or validating quotes before citation; for formatting academic citations, use extract_scholarly_citations instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'claim_statement' ('verification_rigor' defaults to 'multi_source_consensus'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

claim_statement.description: Factual assertion, statistic, or quote requiring independent source verification.

context_domain.description: Optional domain context such as economics, medicine, history, or computer science.

verification_rigor.description: Fact verification method: multi-source consensus, official records only, or probabilistic check.

name: verify_factual_claims

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for verify_factual_claims.

refuting_evidence.description: Contradictory findings or counter-evidence disproving the claim.

supporting_evidence.description: Authoritative statements and sources supporting the claim.

truth_confidence.description: Confidence percentage score between 0.0 and 1.0 in the verdict.

verdict.description: Factual evaluation verdict (VERIFIED_TRUE, DISPUTED, REFUTED_FALSE, UNVERIFIABLE).

title: Fact Verification & Consensus Evidence Evaluator
